highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and broader platform support.
highlights_body: It introduces SKPathBuilder, color font palettes, CICP color spaces, configurable surface sampling, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. This preview also raises the WebAssembly native-asset floor to .NET 8 and removes 32-bit Tizen assets.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later before upgrading.

breaking.title: 32-bit Tizen native assets are removed
breaking.body: The tizen-arm and tizen-x86 native packages are no longer produced after the Skia m147 update. Move Tizen deployments to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion info uses GR casing
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Replace GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo references with the GR-cased type; the compatibility type no longer provides its former equality members.

breaking.title: Assembly version advances to 4.147.0.0
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll moves from assembly version 3.119.0.0 to 4.147.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks when adopting the v4 preview.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 to m147
bullets.detail: The bundled engine brings newer image orientation, HDR and wide-gamut processing, color-aware filters, and accumulated raster and filter correctness fixes.

bullets.lead: Bundled image and font libraries are refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, and libjpeg-turbo to newer upstream releases.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for querying variation axes, cloning at design coordinates, selecting color palettes, and overriding palette entries.
The new builder wraps path mutation after upstream Skia made SKPath immutable; existing mutation methods remain available as obsolete compatibility APIs.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and stream-backed SKData
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData() exposes cheaply available backing data without an intermediate managed copy.

bullets.lead: New rendering, document, GPU, and color-space controls
bullets.detail: Adds SKSamplingOptions surface draws, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, SKDocument.CreateXps, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, and SKMaskFilter.CreateShader.

bullets.lead: Default typefaces initialize safely on Android
bullets.detail: Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font manager and falls back to an empty typeface instead of crashing during startup.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer races its builder
bullets.detail: Disposal avoids flushing an SKPathBuilder after finalization has begun, preventing a native crash when the builder is collected first.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives navigation and tab switches
bullets.detail: Reattached GL views retain their current dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface and rendering blank.

bullets.lead: Font span APIs handle undersized buffers correctly
bullets.detail: Variation and palette queries retry all-or-nothing native calls safely, and ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses into a StackOverflowException.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64
bullets.detail: Dedicated linux-bionic runtime assets support Linux environments based on Android's Bionic libc.
Adds tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 packages while the m147 engine transition retires the 32-bit Tizen targets.

bullets.lead: Apple library target frameworks use the base 26.0 workload
bullets.detail: Versioned library TFMs no longer require Xcode 26.2, while app projects select the workload installed on the build machine.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and compatibility support for modern C# on legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone updates, variable fonts, managed default typefaces, and the SKPath finalizer fix
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Android SKGLView rendering after MAUI navigation and TabBar switches

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Updates to Skia m147, introduces SKPathBuilder, variable fonts, color font palettes, configurable surface sampling, CICP color spaces, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It removes 32-bit Tizen assets and advances the assembly version to 4.147.0.0.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData(), fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and restores broad compatibility for Apple 26.x workloads.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Raises WebAssembly native assets to .NET 8, adds HBColor and missing document, GPU, and mask filter wrappers, and refreshes bundled image and font libraries.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces HBColor for correct hb_color_t channel handling, and ships Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets.
